name: Iquati
description: A people whose abstract memories Jace studied.

timeline.summary: The Iquati's genealogical memory stores were sundered, and they created the Narcomoeba as living recollections.
timeline.quote: The narcomoebae were created as living recollections, as the genealogical memory stores of the Iquati were sundered in some unknown past event.

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jace studies the abstract memories of the Iquati and finds ideas to improve upon.
timeline.quote: In the abstract memories of the Iquati, Jace found interesting ideas to improve upon.

citation.text: Jace's Phantasm (Duel Decks: Jace vs. Vraska, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
